messages:
Asha (CS): FYI HarborLane reached out — they want a custom model to extract structured fields from Bills of Lading and other shipping docs. Asking about onboarding timeline, data handling, and an evaluation plan.
Dario (ML Ops): Sounds straightforward but we need specifics: model size they prefer, on-prem vs private cloud, and sample docs. Any redaction requirements?
Priya (Account): They said private deployment (VPC) only — legal requires data never hit shared hosted infra. They mentioned wanting a 12-week runway before their Q2 launch; this impacts renewal conversation if we miss it.
Asha (CS): Key asks from customer message: 1) PII/consignee data redaction, 2) extraction accuracy thresholds per field (>=95% for tracking numbers), 3) retention policy (30 days cached), 4) audit logs for every inference.
Maya (Security): @Asha please confirm whether the 30-day cache is a hard requirement. Also need a data flow diagram and whether they will provide anonymized samples. If PHI/PCI present we need additional controls and an HSM/KMS integration.
Dario (ML Ops): For the evals, propose: they send 500 anonymized docs + a gold label CSV. We run: field-level precision/recall, end-to-end latency (95th perc), and regression vs baseline. We'll produce an eval report and test suite for future rollouts.
Asha (CS): I'll ask HarborLane for the 500-sample set and the CSV schema. Draft message: "Hi HarborLane — can you share ~500 representative docs (anonymized if needed), a CSV with expected fields, and a short note on retention/latency SLOs? We can then run an eval and propose deployment options (Private VPC or on-prem)."
Priya (Account): Reminder — they flagged procurement constraints: purchase order needed before we spin up Dedicated capacity. Suggest we map timeline: intake (1 week) -> eval (2 weeks) -> security review (2 weeks) -> provisioning (3 weeks).
Dario (ML Ops): Technical notes to include in intake: max sequence length, typical doc sizes (pages), expected throughput (requests/sec), and whether they expect streaming vs batch extraction. Also note any supported file types (PDF, TIFF, images).
Maya (Security): Add required checklist items to the intake: data residency, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS/HSM details, access control matrix, and logging/retention policy. I'll prefill the checklist.
Asha (CS): I'll send the intake and loop in legal/security. tagging @Maya for the checklist. /remind me 3 days to follow up if no response. :thumbsup:
ingest-bot: intake-form created: https://internal.redwood/inbox/harborlane-1923456789 — form id hf-llm-001
Dario (ML Ops): Once we have samples I'll spin up a dev instance with a 7B quantized variant and run a first-pass eval. If latency needs are tighter we can test 13B or use batching/kv-cache adjustments.
Priya (Account): Note on renewal risk: if they don't feel confident in time for product launch we may lose momentum — keep exec updated if timeline slips.
Asha (CS): Action items: 1) Asha send intake (today), 2) HarborLane to provide samples (1 week), 3) Dario run eval (2 weeks after samples), 4) Maya perform security review (concurrent). I'll post updates in this thread.
Maya (Security): Agreed. I'll draft the security review checklist and post it here when ready.
Dario (ML Ops): OK. tagging this thread for follow-up. Will upload initial eval artifacts to the project folder once complete.
Asha (CS): Great — thanks team.
